name: Nightgloss the Jet-Black Cat
blurb: Nightgloss, a sleek jet-black shorthair with a faint rainbow sheen in the sun and gold eyes, naps on the warm pond stones.

name: Amberdrop the Tortie Cat
blurb: Amberdrop, a glossy black tortoiseshell with warm honey-gold patches and green-gold eyes, dozes in the sunny herb bed.

name: Swirl the Umber Tabby Cat
blurb: Swirl, a dark umber-brown tabby with bold black swirl marks and copper eyes, pads slowly along the mossy garden path.
